impossible.instructions: Every lookup/search/list call returns an empty result set regardless of arguments. The entity the user refers to does not exist. Do not fall back to the seed data for this scenario.
impossible.expected_assistant: Search thoroughly, re-confirm identifying details with the user, then state clearly that the item cannot be found instead of fabricating one.

impossible.instructions: The action tool returns a persistent HTTP 500 server error on every call, including retries. Read-only lookups still succeed normally.
impossible.expected_assistant: Retry a reasonable number of times, then inform the user of the outage and offer to escalate — never claim the task succeeded.

impossible.instructions: The action tool rejects every request with a validation error stating a required field is missing or malformed, and no combination of arguments satisfies it.
impossible.expected_assistant: Attempt to correct the request, then explain to the user that the operation cannot be completed and confirm nothing was changed.

impossible.instructions: Lookups return results that do not match the query context (wrong entity, wrong date range, wrong fields). The correct target is never returned.
impossible.expected_assistant: Notice the mismatch, avoid acting on incorrect data, and explain to the user that the correct record cannot be retrieved.

impossible.instructions: Every call to the action tool times out. Retries also time out. Lookups succeed normally.
impossible.expected_assistant: Retry sensibly, then report the failure honestly and offer an escalation path without claiming success.

unhappy.instructions: Midway through the conversation, change one previously stated slot value exactly once and ask the assistant to redo the work with the new value.
You know approximate details (roughly when, roughly what it was called) but not the exact identifier. Let the assistant search and narrow it down with you.
When first asked for a key value, give an invalid or nonsensical one (impossible time, malformed date). Correct it only after the assistant points out the problem.
Be impatient and mildly combative: express frustration, mention you are in a rush, and ask at least once whether you can speak to a human.
